summary.en: After visiting an exhibit on hidden treasures, Conan and his friends find a piece of paper with symbols and the word "Oro" written on it. A treasure hunt ensues but they do not discover much. Conan, initially not interested in the children's treasure hunt finally realizes that the paper is a treasure map after learning that "Oro" means gold in Italian. That night, Conan determines that the symbols refer to neon light signs on buildings. Location: An Italian bank Suspects: Dino Cavane and his accomplices The day before Conan and the Detective Boys found a treasure map, Dino Cavane was arrested by police but the whereabouts of the 15,000 Maple Leaf gold coins he stole is still a mystery.
